headline: "Give Us One Chance to Recover Our Money": Retail Investors Stuck Near 7,500 Hold Tens of Trillions of Won in Shares, What Now? [Investment 360]
summary: The KOSPI is trading below the 7,000 level and investor sentiment has frozen. Retail investors bought shares during the downturn and now hold large positions, making a quick return to an uptrend difficult even if the index rebounds.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main stock benchmark, covering the country's largest listed companies. Retail investor holdings and sentiment can shape how quickly the market recovers after a sell-off.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The article reports the index trading below 7,000 and describes weak sentiment and retail holdings bought during the decline.
